items.label: Chest Press
items.cue: Handles at mid-chest. Press, don't shrug.

items.label: Seated Row
items.cue: The new triangle grip goes here. Sit tall, pull to the navel, squeeze the shoulder blades, slow return.

items.label: Leg Extension
items.cue: Roller on the shins, kick to full lock, squeeze one second, lower slow.

items.label: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
items.station: Floor · dumbbells, or the 20 kg kettlebell in both hands
items.cue: This replaces the leg curl. Soft knees, push the hips back, weights slide down the thighs until you feel the hamstrings stretch, then stand tall. Back stays flat — the knees barely move.

items.label: Rope Pushdown
items.cue: Elbows pinned to your sides, split the rope at the bottom.

items.label: Cable Crunch
items.cue: Optional. Rope beside the ears, curl the ribs to the hips, hips stay still.

items.label: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
items.cue: Chest up, bar to the upper chest, elbows down and back.

items.label: Dumbbell Bench Press
items.cue: Lie back, dumbbells at chest level, press up and slightly together. Lower until the elbows are level with the bench.

items.label: Goblet Squat
items.cue: Hold the kettlebell by the horns at your chest. Sit straight down between the heels, elbows inside the knees, chest tall.

items.label: Kettlebell Swing
items.station: Floor · the 20 kg kettlebell, both hands
items.cue: Both hands on the handle (the photo shows one arm — use two). Hinge at the hips, snap them forward, let the bell float to chest height. It's a hip snap, not a lift with the arms.

items.label: Cable Preacher Curl
items.station: Low pulley · silver bar on the arm-curl pad
items.cue: Upper arms glued to the pad. Full stretch at the bottom, no bouncing.

items.label: Cable Wood Chop
items.cue: Optional. Arms straight, rotate from the hips, pivot the back foot.

fb-c.name: Full Body C
fb-c.focus: Shoulders · back · single leg · side delts

items.label: Seated Shoulder Press
items.cue: Sit on the bench, back straight, dumbbells at ear height. Press overhead without arching the lower back.

items.label: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
items.station: Bench · one hand and knee on it
items.cue: Flat back, pull the dumbbell to your hip, elbow past your ribs. Don't twist — the shoulders stay level.

items.label: Bulgarian Split Squat
items.station: Bench · back foot on it, dumbbells at your sides
items.cue: Back foot on the bench, front foot a long step out. Drop straight down, front heel stays flat. Start light — balance is the hard part.

items.label: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
items.cue: Lighter than you think. Lead with the elbows, stop at shoulder height, lower slow.

items.label: Face Pull
items.cue: Pull to the forehead, elbows high, finish with a double-biceps pose.

warmup.label: Arm Circles
warmup.cue: Big slow circles, forward then backward. Loosen the shoulders.

warmup.label: Band Pull-Apart
warmup.cue: Band at chest height, arms straight. Pull it apart until it touches your chest, squeeze the shoulder blades, slow return.

warmup.label: Bodyweight Squats
warmup.cue: Fifteen easy squats. Warm the knees and hips, sit deep.

warmup.label: Inchworms
warmup.cue: Walk the hands out to a plank, walk the feet in. Five reps.

cooldown.label: Chest Stretch
cooldown.cue: Hands on the frame behind you, lean forward until the chest opens.

cooldown.label: Lat Stretch
cooldown.cue: Hold the frame overhead, sit the hips back and away from the hand.

cooldown.label: Quad Stretch
cooldown.cue: Heel to glute, knees together, hips forward.

cooldown.label: Hamstring Stretch
cooldown.cue: Heel on the seat, leg straight, hinge from the hips.

cooldown.label: Hip Flexor Stretch
cooldown.cue: Back knee down, tuck the pelvis, push the hips forward.

cooldown.label: Child's Pose
cooldown.cue: Sit back on the heels, arms long, breathe slow. Done.

equipment: Sparnod SHG-10000 — 138 lb stack, press arm, high + low pulley, arm-curl pad, leg developer
Pulley grips — triceps rope and triangle (close-grip) handle
